thread:
Priya: Heads-up: several SMB accounts asked for a predictable low-cost lite tier for small chat use cases. They called out both latency and billing clarity.
Omar: Do we have metrics for short-turnaround chats? what's the median token length and current p95 latency for under-20-token prompts?
Ken: Pricing flagged this in yesterday's rev ops meeting. SMBs want a flat micro-sla (X requests/min) not per-token surprises. Could be a new SKU.
Zoe: Sales intel: competitors are bundling a 1c/chat message floor and advertising 30ms avg. Customers compare price more than subtle quality diffs.
Avery: UX thought: keep console simple. Add a "Micro tier" toggle + inline tooltip. Must expose API header to force full-quality path.
Priya: Scope proposal: (A) routing rule that sends requests with <=24 tokens to a low-cost model variant, (B) a console toggle and API header to opt out, (C) a billing meter for micro-request units, (D) docs and a one-page FAQ for sales.
Omar: Engineering note: we can roll this by creating a lightweight 4-bit quantized build of our 6B tuned model and a short KV cache for prefix hits. Perf estimate: ~6 eng-days + 2 infra days.
Ken: Billing ask: need an idempotent meter tag so downstream billing can credit micro-units. Also need limits to avoid DOS via many tiny requests.
Zoe: Can we offer a pilot price for early adopters? Sales wants an introductory credit for first 3 months. Need legal sign-off if SLA differs.
Avery: API UX: header x-redwood-quality: high|micro. Console: toggle plus per-route override. Quick mock attached in Figma (link in thread).
Priya: Launch criteria suggestion: 1) p50 latency for <=24 token requests < 45ms in US-east, 2) micro-unit cost < 50% of standard per-message cost, 3) billing emits micro_unit tag for 100% of routed requests, 4) no >7% negative quality delta on smoke prompt set.
Omar: Ops/backstop: automatic fallback to standard model on hallucination score >0.7 or if micro path errors >0.2% over 1h. Also expose an internal debug stream for routed vs full responses.
Ken: Risk: introducing new SKU increases billing complexity and support tickets. Mitigation: limit to hosted only and cap concurrent micro-sessions per tenant.
Zoe: Sales risk: some enterprise customers will try to push micro into Dedicated. Recommend policy: micro only for hosted plans initially.
Avery: Copy note: add clear language "Designed for short, low-detail exchanges. Not recommended for financial/legal reasoning."
Priya: Owner: me. Omar + Eng-Infra to confirm infra estimate today. Ken to prototype billing tags. Zoe to recruit two pilot SMBs. Avery to deliver API mock + console copy by Thu.
product-bot: New RFC created: https://redwood/secure/rfcs/512-micro-tier-routing-assimilation ! Assigned Priya; reviewers Ken/Omar.
Omar: Quick follow-up: need a regression harness for the micro model type. I'll throw together a small eval set for the pilot.
Ken: I'll draft a billing spec and limit table. Will loop finance.
Zoe: I'll confirm two pilot commitments and draft pilot terms.
Avery: will post Figma link and copy PR before EOD Thu.
Priya: Meeting scheduled tomorrow 11am to finalize scope. If anyone objects to hosted-only micro-tier, raise now. Otherwise we proceed to RFC review.
Omar: no objections from infra.
Ken: fine from billing side, need finance review.
Zoe: sales green.
Avery: UX ok.
Priya: Closing thread ! owner flagged. Next: RFC review and pilot onboarding.
